text:
**The evidence does not establish whether the owner broke the law.**

Satellite data supports tree-cover loss on the property after 2020: 81.3 hectares in 2021, 0.6 hectares in 2022 and 4.5 hectares in 2023. Most of the recorded loss was in a planted-forest context.

Tree-cover loss can result from plantation harvesting, fire, storms or clearing. The data does not establish the cause, who was responsible, whether land use changed, or whether any activity was authorized. Determining legality would require checking the applicable laws, permits and records of what occurred.
